feature: Customer Portal Sign-in Help (/login/help) -- Git #1349. A public, mostly client-side page for a locked-out/unauthenticated user: a service-status strip (reuses the existing GET /api/status check), a 5-item FAQ accordion (first item open by default, static copy), two static cards, and ShaneBot. ShaneBot raises a REAL Zoho Desk ticket via POST /api/portal/sign-in-help/ticket -> lib/zoho-desk.ts raiseSignInHelpTicket() (synchronous exception to the queue-only write rule so a real reference can be returned on the spot), attaching the account's REAL recent successful sign-ins + current lockout state (there is no per-attempt/failed-login log on this platform -- only user_sessions successful logins + the failed_login_attempts counter/locked_until on the user row; documented honestly rather than fabricated).
notes: shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these assertions only go green once this session's commit is deployed by the dev-server rebuild.,THE FULL TICKET-CREATION HAPPY PATH (real SM-4xxxx reference) IS NOT ASSERTED HERE: raiseSignInHelpTicket requires live Zoho Desk credentials + ZOHO_DESK_DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_ID, which the local/test harness does not carry, so the endpoint returns 502 there. What IS asserted is the route's real input VALIDATION (400s), which needs no Zoho, plus the page + accordion + ShaneBot flow up to the email step.,SIGN-IN 'ATTEMPTS' ATTACHMENT IS SUCCESSFUL-LOGIN HISTORY, NOT FAILED-ATTEMPT ROWS: this platform logs successful sign-ins (user_sessions) + a failed-attempt counter/lockout state on the user row, but NOT individual failed attempts. The ticket attaches the real former; the design's 'last ten sign-in attempts' bot copy is kept verbatim.,THE PAGE IS PUBLIC (no login block) -- the user is locked out by definition, so /login/help and its POST must not require auth. UI route shape: /portal/{slug}/login/help (slug-scoped, declared in SlugInnerSwitch).,NO 'signed in but portal is empty' FAQ ITEM -- deliberately excluded by design (a scan gate holds the portal closed until first scan, so that state does not exist).,ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL.
